settings.title: Real people. Real results.
settings.body: Verified reviews from the barre, Pilates, and Lagree floor.

I was dreading going back to Pilates after a spinal fusion because I felt like grip socks were not going to cut it. I had never found a pair of grip socks that wouldn't slip a bit while doing bridges on the chair or reformer so I started looking for something that would help alleviate my fears.
settings.author: Samantha B.

settings.body: All grip and no slip, I love them. I have neuropathy in my feet and can't keep grip socks on they slide off. This is the best grip for me.
settings.author: Tracie

settings.body: I bought these after hearing all of the stories my wife tells me about going through socks like crazy. She takes a class at Pilates 5 days a week and wears out her socks fast. They have been a huge hit with her and several other ladies in the class.
settings.author: Doug G.
